name: Wooden Invitation Card With Envelope
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    Crafted from high-quality natural wood, each invitation card features a smooth finish perfect for precision UV printing and intricate laser-cut designs. The set includes a blank white paper insert for handwritten messages and a premium paper envelope in your choice of three elegant colors: light khaki, white, or black.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

Envelope Options:

Black: 10 × 7 cm (3.94 × 2.76 inches)

➤ A6 Set Includes:

White Paper Insert (Blank): 13 × 8.7 cm (5.12 × 3.42 inches)

  • UV Printing Technology:
    Printed on both sides using state-of-the-art UV printing, these cards boast vibrant, long-lasting colors and sharp detail. Perfect for personalization — names, event details, custom artwork, or messages — making every card truly one-of-a-kind.

 

  • Multi-Purpose Use:
  • Ideal for a wide range of occasions, including: Wedding Invitations, Save-the-Date Cards, Baby, Announcements, Bridal Showers, Party or Event Invitations, Thank You Notes, Holiday Greetings
  • Its sturdy wooden design ensures it becomes a lasting keepsake, not just another card to toss away.
  • A Thoughtful Gift for Any Occasion:
    Whether you're celebrating a wedding, anniversary, birthday, graduation, or any special event, this wooden invitation card is more than a greeting — it's a memorable gift your recipient will want to keep and cherish.

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
